hardened: Units block attacks but never sight or spotting (decision 2026-10-25).
Own units never block own shots; hills and fliers ignore unit blocking.
Melee (max range 1) needs base contact <= 10, with pile in at Engagement start.
Enemy bumps stay in contact; friend/rock bumps back away at half the remaining move; bumped units lose actions.
Tie picks persist all battle per phase; computer opponents never get pick prompts.
One-click attack when one weapon option is intentional.
Spectators see every unit; dead enemy units stay visible under fog (decision 2026-10-25).
LAN with no auth; client-generated tokens; one process is one table.
No touch-screen pinch zoom (documented). The side-panel dial coexists with the map dial.
docs/STATUS.html is a marked historical snapshot.
The blank die face is deliberately plain (low contrast by design: it carries no symbol).
A masked attacker (attack.attacker null) only reaches the target owner for an earlier unseen attack; live attacks reveal the attacker (firedRound).
README says 60 to 300 DP: that is what the host can pick; the server accepts 40 to 300 by design.
learnings: Mutation runs on a scratch copy are the highest-yield test lens here: 69 of 102 survived in cycle 1.
Balance regressions after rules changes came from AI planning twice (facing, bump avoidance): diagnose per-unit attack availability before touching costs.
Hand-placed test geometry lies: assert the premise (range band, contact) before the behavior.

Re-reviewing this cycle's own fixes found 7 regressions (focus vs shortcut, dial drift, tie ordering, armies erase, beat close, banner text, cost display): the Phase 6 re-review is mandatory, not optional.

Mutation-check every new test the moment it is written: 4 new tests this cycle passed for the wrong reason (2-player surrender ended the battle; pile-in rock premise; 3-way tie; rock-hop geometry) until a planted bug showed they could not fail.
gate.sh and commit.sh helper scripts in the session scratchpad kept 20 commits consistent (Leefless identity, push, account switch back).
